name: Paul
note: The apostle, once a persecutor, now defending the gospel of grace.

name: The believers in Galatia
note: Gentile Christians being pressed to be circumcised.

name: The agitators
note: Teachers who "trouble" the Galatians and want them to be circumcised; Paul does not name them.

name: Cephas (Peter)
note: The apostle Simon Peter, whom Paul visited and later confronted in Antioch.

name: James, the Lord's brother
note: A leader of the Jerusalem church.

name: Barnabas
note: Paul's partner, who was swept along by the pressure in Antioch.

name: Titus
note: A Greek believer who was not forced to be circumcised.

name: Abraham
note: The father of the faithful, justified by faith.

name: Jesus
note: The crucified Messiah who redeemed us from the curse of the law.
